purpose: M2-C three-image multimodal provider and Isaac Sim evaluation

fixtures.author: Jandrinov
fixtures.prompt: Use the attached image as the primary layout evidence. Model the visible narrow pallet-rack aisle, preserve one clear positive-X route for the driven AGV, and omit unsupported details rather than inventing them.

fixtures.author: Aspasturias
fixtures.prompt: Use the attached image as the primary layout evidence. Model the asymmetric parts-storage shelving and a visible clear aisle for one positive-X AGV route. Omit unsupported vehicles or people instead of misclassifying them as AGVs.

fixtures.author: Jacinta Quesada / FEMA
fixtures.prompt: Use the attached image as the primary layout evidence. Model the wide pallet-staging warehouse with pallet stacks along the sides and one clear center positive-X AGV route. Do not model people.
